#!/bin/sh
set -eu

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
spool=$base/spool
delivered=$base/delivered
quarantine=$base/quarantine
index=$delivered/index.tsv
tmp=

mkdir -p "$delivered" "$quarantine"

# Serialize recovery runs without leaving a lock file in the spool tree.
exec 9<"$0"
flock 9

cleanup() {
    status=$?
    if [ -n "$tmp" ]; then
        rm -f -- "$tmp"
    fi
    exit "$status"
}
trap cleanup 0

if [ ! -e "$index" ]; then
    tmp=$(mktemp "$delivered/.index.XXXXXX")
    printf 'message_id\tfile\n' > "$tmp"
    chmod 0644 "$tmp"
    mv -- "$tmp" "$index"
    tmp=
fi

if [ ! -f "$index" ]; then
    printf 'error: delivery index is not a regular file: %s\n' "$index" >&2
    exit 1
fi

for message in "$spool"/*.eml; do
    [ -f "$message" ] || continue
    name=$(basename -- "$message")

    if message_id=$(awk '
        {
            line = $0
            sub(/\r$/, "", line)
            if (line == "")
                exit
            colon = index(line, ":")
            if (colon > 0 && tolower(substr(line, 1, colon - 1)) == "message-id") {
                value = substr(line, colon + 1)
                sub(/^[[:space:]]*/, "", value)
                sub(/[[:space:]]*$/, "", value)
                count++
            }

                print value
                exit 0
            }
            exit 1
        }

        if awk -F '\t' -v wanted="$message_id" '
            NR > 1 && $1 == wanted { found = 1 }
            END { exit(found ? 0 : 1) }
        ' "$index"

            printf 'skip: %s already delivered (%s)\n' "$name" "$message_id"
            continue
        fi

        destination=$delivered/$name

            number=1
            while :; do
                destination=$delivered/$name.recovered-$number

            cp -p -- "$message" "$tmp"
            mv -- "$tmp" "$destination"
            tmp=

        printf '%s\n' 'Malformed message: missing, empty, duplicate, or syntactically invalid Message-ID header.' > "$tmp"
        chmod 0644 "$tmp"
        if [ -f "$reason" ] && cmp -s -- "$tmp" "$reason"; then
            rm -f -- "$tmp"
        else
            mv -- "$tmp" "$reason"

        printf 'quarantined: %s (%s)\n' "$name" "$(basename -- "$reason")"

base=$(CDPATH= cd -- "$(dirname -- "$0")/.." && pwd)
spool=$base/spool
delivered=$base/delivered
quarantine=$base/quarantine
index=$delivered/index.tsv
tmp=

mkdir -p "$delivered" "$quarantine"

# Serialize recovery runs without leaving a lock file in the spool tree.
exec 9<"$0"
flock 9

cleanup() {
    status=$?
    if [ -n "$tmp" ]; then
        rm -f -- "$tmp"
    fi
    exit "$status"
}
trap cleanup 0

if [ ! -e "$index" ]; then
    tmp=$(mktemp "$delivered/.index.XXXXXX")
    printf 'message_id\tfile\n' > "$tmp"
    chmod 0644 "$tmp"
    mv -- "$tmp" "$index"
    tmp=
fi

if [ ! -f "$index" ]; then
    printf 'error: delivery index is not a regular file: %s\n' "$index" >&2
    exit 1
fi

for message in "$spool"/*.eml; do
    [ -f "$message" ] || continue
    name=$(basename -- "$message")

    if message_id=$(awk '
        {
            line = $0
            sub(/\r$/, "", line)
            if (line == "")
                exit
            colon = index(line, ":")
            if (colon > 0 && tolower(substr(line, 1, colon - 1)) == "message-id") {
                value = substr(line, colon + 1)
                sub(/^[[:space:]]*/, "", value)
                sub(/[[:space:]]*$/, "", value)
                count++
            }
        }
        END {
            if (count == 1 && value ~ /^<[^<>[:space:]]+>$/) {
                print value
                exit 0
            }
            exit 1
        }
    ' "$message")
    then
        if awk -v wanted="$message_id" '
            NR > 1 {
                line = $0
                sub(/\r$/, "", line)
                sub(/^[[:space:]]+/, "", line)
                split(line, fields, /[[:space:]]+/)
                if (fields[1] == wanted)
                    found = 1
            }
            END { exit(found ? 0 : 1) }
        ' "$index"
        then
            printf 'skip: %s already delivered (%s)\n' "$name" "$message_id"
            continue
        fi

        destination=$delivered/$name
        if [ -e "$destination" ] && ! cmp -s -- "$message" "$destination"; then
            number=1
            while :; do
                destination=$delivered/$name.recovered-$number
                if [ ! -e "$destination" ] || cmp -s -- "$message" "$destination"; then
                    break
                fi
                number=$((number + 1))
            done
        fi

        if [ ! -e "$destination" ]; then
            tmp=$(mktemp "$delivered/.message.XXXXXX")
            cp -p -- "$message" "$tmp"
            mv -- "$tmp" "$destination"
            tmp=
        fi

        printf '%s\t%s\n' "$message_id" "$(basename -- "$destination")" >> "$index"
        printf 'delivered: %s as %s (%s)\n' "$name" "$(basename -- "$destination")" "$message_id"
    else
        destination=$quarantine/$name
        if [ -e "$destination" ] && ! cmp -s -- "$message" "$destination"; then
            number=1
            while :; do
                destination=$quarantine/$name.quarantined-$number
                if [ ! -e "$destination" ] || cmp -s -- "$message" "$destination"; then
                    break
                fi
                number=$((number + 1))
            done
        fi

        if [ ! -e "$destination" ]; then
            tmp=$(mktemp "$quarantine/.message.XXXXXX")
            cp -p -- "$message" "$tmp"
            mv -- "$tmp" "$destination"
            tmp=
        fi

        reason=$destination.reason.txt
        tmp=$(mktemp "$quarantine/.reason.XXXXXX")
        printf '%s\n' 'Malformed message: missing, empty, duplicate, or syntactically invalid Message-ID header.' > "$tmp"
        chmod 0644 "$tmp"
        if [ -f "$reason" ] && cmp -s -- "$tmp" "$reason"; then
            rm -f -- "$tmp"
        else
            mv -- "$tmp" "$reason"
        fi
        tmp=
        printf 'quarantined: %s (%s)\n' "$name" "$(basename -- "$reason")"
    fi
done

trap - 0
ANTRIEB_REPLAY_EOF
chown --reference="$target" "$tmp"
chmod --reference="$target" "$tmp"
chcon --reference="$target" "$tmp"
sh -n "$tmp"
printf '%s\n' '[script-checksums-old-new]'
sha256sum "$target" "$tmp"
mv -f -- "$tmp" "$target"
tmp=
printf '%s\n' '[installed-metadata]'
stat -c '%A %U:%G %s %n' "$target"
ls -lZ "$target"
sh -n "$target"

base=/srv/legacy2/mail-spool-deduplication
printf '%s\n' '[live-recovery]'
"$base/bin/replay"
printf '%s\n' '[exit-status]'
printf '0\n'
